data: The log shows the compilation of a C++ core library containing various utility and networking modules. The process failed because socket.cpp attempted to call the undeclared function connect_timeout, triggering a fatal compilation error.

A C++ core library was being compiled from multiple source files in the src directory. The build failed due to a compilation error in src/socket.cpp where the function connect_timeout was not declared in the current scope.
The logs show the compilation of a C++ core library from multiple source files. The build failed because the `connect_timeout` identifier was not declared in scope within `src/socket.cpp`.
